2.69.29
Table.Footer
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Table.Footer element specifies the collection of footer rows in a Table. This element is optional
and is of type Footer.
Following is the parent element of the Table.Footer element.
Parent elements
Table
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Table.Footer element.
 <xsd:element name="Footer" type="FooterType" minOccurs="0" />
